text:
sam: FYI customs at FRA flagged our inbound H100 replacement shipment as commercial value. Forwarder says missing supplier declaration, now on hold. can vendor confirm paperwork?
lauren: which AWB? were running low on edge capacity if this stalls.
ev an-forwarder: AWB: 234-98765432. customs flagged HS mismatch (8473 vs 8542) and want supplier-signed invoice + PO ref. currently flagged as 'commercial import'.
sam: these are RMA replacements, not a fresh sale. can the vendor mark as 'return for repair' or 'warranty replacement' on docs to avoid duties?
max-vendor: i'll push to supply ops now. curious if we can do a partial release to avoid full delay?
kai: partial release OK. if 4 units clear we can hot-swap into the EU edge cluster and avoid throttling.
lauren: what's the cost delta for splitting AWBs and extra broker fees? need to weigh against cluster downtime.
max-vendor: vendorco estimates 420 for split handling + 55 per extra AWB admin. they offered to pick up 210 as goodwill if paperwork delay is on our broker.
ops-bot: cost_event logged: tag=procurement.split_shipment amount=420 reason=split_handling (1715560200)
ev an-forwarder: customs will accept repair/warranty notation but requires: 1) supplier signed statement; 2) original PO/contract ref; 3) serial manifest. If any item missing customs will issue duty assessment.
sam: attaching serials below. vendor please send signed statement and annotated invoice to broker email (broker@fra-forwarder.example)
SN-H100-202601
SN-H100-202602
SN-H100-202603
SN-H100-202604
SN-H100-202605
SN-H100-202606
SN-H100-202607
SN-H100-202608
lauren: vendor, can you explicitly state "warranty replacement - no commercial value" and include the original PO number PO-98765? customs wants exact wording.
max-vendor: acknowledged. supply ops will stamped-declare with that wording within ~3 hours. they asked whether we authorize split AWB (ship 4 now, 4 after docs).
kai: authorize split. route first 4 to FRA local clearance -> AMS crossdock -> DC staging. second 4 to follow once docs in.
sam: vendor - please confirm they will attach RMA return labels to units and include serial manifest in airwaybill. Confirm vendor coverage of at least half AWB admin fee (55) as concession.
max-vendor: vendorco agrees to cover 55 now (half of admin) and will reimburse additional if clearance causes them to expedite. final ack by EOD.
ev an-forwarder: ETA if docs arrive within 3h: 24-30h for first split clear + delivery to DC. if docs delay, customs may request re-export.
lauren: ops, prep staging slot and set reserved tag so these units don't get re-assigned. kai, you'll coordinate swap schedule.
kai: will book hot-swap window once we have 24h ETA. keep me posted if the first 4 improve cluster metrics.
sam: thanks. will follow up if vendor docs come in. :thumbsup:
